sections.heading: Common Login Issues and Their Solutions

content.text: Even if the process is easy, users may have problems signing in. Here are common issues and solutions:

Click "Forgot Password." on the login screen to reset your password. The system will send password reset instructions to your signup email. Players can log in immediately after updating their password.
The casino may temporarily lock an account for security reasons after many failed attempts. You can either wait a few minutes and try again or call customer service to unlock the account.
If the login page doesn’t load correctly, clear browser cache and cookies, or switch to another browser. Using private mode can also bypass stored session errors.
A weak internet connection may interrupt login. Ensure the network is stable and VPNs are disabled, as some may block casino access.
If login fails due to unverified status, complete the verification process. Once approved, access will be fully restored.
It's just as vital to log out precisely as it is to log in. "Logout" or "Sign Out" is usually next to the player's identity in the account menu that opens.
When you click on it, it disconnects the account and ends the session. This stops other people from seeing the profile, especially on a computer that is shared.
Logging out is recommended since closing the browser window does not always end a session.
